blurb: Guests soar over the Outer Banks in a 1942 open-cockpit biplane or a Cessna 172. They see dolphins, sea turtles, shipwrecks, the Wright Brothers’ Monument, Bodie Island Lighthouse, and other popular attractions from the air. Tours depart from Dare County Regional Airport in Manteo, NC.
extraNote: Dare County Regional Airport in Manteo, just past the NC Aquarium on Airport Road. Turn left once you enter the airport parking lot and look for the big tan hangar.

quotes.author: Trip Advisor
quotes.text: WWII Airplane Ride - FANTASTIC Andy is a terrific pilot. Wife wanted an open cockpit biplane ride for her birthday and I've always wanted to ride in a WWII warbird. We got both with Andy in his 1942 Waco UPF-7. He did a great job telling us what we were flying around, circling dolphins and a shipwreck. The ride in this plane is smooth as silk and can't be beat. We were grinning ear to ear when we landed. Only disappointing part was it had to end. Highly recommend Andy and flights around Nags Head to everyone. Reviewed June 13, 2016

quotes.author: Trip Advisor
quotes.text: Biplane ride was amazing! I had always wanted to fly open cockpit, and the opportunity to do it in a 77-year old WWII training airplane over the Wright Brothers monument was amazing. The people at Barrier Island Aviation were great, and the views of the shoreline along the Outer Banks were terrific – got to see shipwrecks under the sea just off shore the day we flew. It was tight, but both my daughter and I were able fit in the passenger seat up front. One off the bucket list for me! Reviewed August 2019

quotes.author: Trip Advisor
quotes.text: Amazing Experience We actually booked this as a special experience for our honeymoon. I have cerebral palsy, and the pilot was very patient helping me get in and out of the plane. We did the 35 minute tour, and while our tour was booked for a Tuesday morning we accidentally showed up Monday and the staff was very kind and accommodating. I would absolutely recommend this experience to anyone looking for a fun and special way to see the area! Reviewed October 2018

quotes.author: Trip Advisor
quotes.text: A Must Do In The OBX If your looking for something that's fun and a little different, you have to book a Bi-plane Tour with Barrier Island Aviation. Andy (pilot) and Amy (staff) are very friendly and accommodating. I can't tell you how exciting and fun it is to ride in an open cockpit bi-plane. We did the 20 minute tour and the views of the area from 1000 ft. are fantastic! Much thanks to Andy and Amy for a very enjoyable time! Reviewed October 2018

quotes.author: Trip Advisor
quotes.text: Fantastic Experience!” My husband and I took an hour long trip in the Cessna down towards Cape Hatteras to celebrate our 1st Anniversary. The views were breathtaking and seeing the lighthouses & vast beaches from the air was awesome! Shipwrecks were also pointed out and some areas of fish. Our pilot was a great time and had a great sense of humor! Pointed out a lot of things. This is definitely something I would do again! Visited April 2016

quotes.author: Trip Advisor
quotes.text: Wonderful way to see the entire beauty of the Outer Banks! We took the Cessna 206 so that our family of 4 cold fly together. The day was perfect; mother nature was happy, the water was clear and Andy made the trip over the top. Having a wonderful tour guide makes or breaks the experience and Andy definitely made the experience amazing. If we ever visit the Banks again, we will visit the Barrier Island Aviation. Reviewed June 7, 2016
